title: Toronto: Niagara Falls Day tour: Boat, Journey Behind and Tower
includes: Toronto to Niagara Falls round trip transportation
Memorable photo opportunities – at all major attractions.
Expert Guide Assistance – help navigating attractions, best photo spots, and a smooth experience.
Hornblower Boat Cruise – experience the power and spray of the iconic Falls
Skylon Tower Observation Deck – panoramic views of Niagara Falls, Niagara River, and landscapes.
Journey Behind the Falls – Skip-the-line tickets
Maple tasting experience – included in your package, sampling authentic Canadian maple.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
Passports not required as there will be no crossing of the borders
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Take a once-a-lifetime opportunity to visit Niagara Falls' Most Iconic Attractions. Starting Your Tour from Toronto head to Niagara Falls, and experience the Most Popular attraction including Hornblower Cruise, Journey behind the Falls, and Skylon Tower at Niagara Falls. Your tour guide will ensure that your tour will be fun and memorable, offering insights and tips along the way. Finish your day by tasting the lovely Canadian maple syrup, and local fudge and chocolate.
